last_3_hypotheses: Worker fan-out timing is dominated by the first wrapper request, not the slowest, because the orchestrator awaits the dispatch ACK serially before issuing the next worker call.
BGE-M3 underperforms on game-theory abstracts because the field's terminology is highly domain-specific and the M3 training distribution contains relatively few game-theory papers.
The Day-7 retrospective's word count is uncorrelated with the number of carryover items declared the following Monday.
proposed_hypothesis_text: Embedding similarity is unreliable as a retrieval signal for game-theory papers because the vocabulary (folk theorem, refinement, equilibrium selection) is specialized enough that general-purpose embedders like BGE-M3 collapse semantic distinctions.
rationale: Same artifact (BGE-M3) and same root cause (game-theory vocabulary is specialized, embedder under-represents it). The proposed version provides specific examples of the specialized vocabulary, which is presentation polish rather than a new claim.
